data.long_meaning: Derived from Old German, the name Hartzel is composed of two parts: 'Herz' meaning 'heart' and 'El' meaning 'God'. The name Hartzel symbolizes a deep connection and devotion to God, as if one's heart is filled with divine love. The name Hartzel carries the meaning “Herz = heart, El = God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hartzel usually hope their child will grow to embody herz = heart, el = god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
